purpose: Fresh paired confirmation separating the value of the index65 threshold from the marginal value of the +32 compile probe. The prior 918xxx/919xxx confirmation validated the composite probe97-gap47 rule but a post-hoc diagnostic found no incremental recovered gain from probing relative to applying the same threshold at index65. This protocol is frozen before any 920xxx/921xxx outcome is evaluated.
seed_novelty_check: Repository search before creation found no own-role occurrence of exact seeds 920000 or 921000.
search_contract: Exactly the frozen ROBDD/local-relocation substrate and endpoint oracle used by coalition_seeded_probe97_gap47_confirmation_v0. Retain the verified natural+RCM incumbent. Audit full seeded challenger tails for evaluation only. Every candidate BDD compilation is charged.
population: Evaluate paired policies only on frozen-v1 stop states: challenger active at index65, no verified challenger improvement over incumbent by index65, and gap65 > 11.

policies.direct_gap65_47: At a v1-stop state, buy the full remaining challenger tail iff gap65 <= 47; otherwise stop. Merge only verified improvements.
policies.probe97_gap47: At every v1-stop state, execute through min(index97, exhaustion). If exhausted, merge verified improvement and stop. Otherwise buy the full remaining tail iff gap97 <= 47. Merge only verified improvements.
policies.exhaustive_audit: Finish every v1-stop challenger tail regardless of deployed decision, solely to measure available gain and false negatives. Audit-only work is excluded from deployed compute.

support_gate.if_failed: INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_POSITIVE_SUPPORT; do not tune either policy on this split.

required: deployed compiles <= 0.35 of exhaustive stop-tail compiles

probe_incremental_component.incremental_gain: probe recovered gain minus direct recovered gain
probe_incremental_component.incremental_compute: probe deployed compiles minus direct deployed compiles
justified_if: incremental compute <= 0.15 of exhaustive stop-tail compiles
probe_incremental_component.no_incremental_value_if: incremental gain <= 0; do not claim the probe itself is validated even if the composite probe policy meets absolute quality/compute thresholds.

secondary: first certificate index for direct/probe misses
no_adaptation: Do not alter gap threshold 47, probe checkpoint 97, seed list, support gate, success rules, search contract or cost accounting after any 920xxx/921xxx outcome is opened. Do not use 918xxx/919xxx for fitting or threshold changes in this test.
scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering only; not theorem-proving evidence.
